"""Bounded BF16 adapter export comparison; no training or release holdout evaluation."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import mlx.core as mx
source=Path('Models/Artifacts/composition-qwen-adapter-v2')
model=Path('Models/Artifacts/composition-qwen-adapter-bf16')
assert not model.exists()
subprocess.run(['/bin/cp','-cR',str(source),str(model)],check=True)
weights=mx.load(str(source/'adapters/adapters.safetensors'))
assert len(weights)==248 and all(w.dtype==mx.float32 for w in weights.values())
mx.save_safetensors(str(model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors'),{k:v.astype(mx.bfloat16) for k,v in weights.items()})
del weights
mx.clear_cache()
runs={}
for label,extra in [('development',[]),('training-fit',['--gold','.build/composition-training-fit-gold.jsonl'])]:
    output=Path('.build/composition-bf16-'+label)
    with Path(str(output)+'.log').open('w') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',
            '.build/out/Products/Debug/PoptartCleanupEval','--model',str(model),
            '--output-directory',str(output),*extra],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=600)
    runs[label]={**{n:json.loads((output/(n+'.json')).read_text()) for n in ['report','evidence','failures']},
                 'predictions':[json.loads(l) for l in (output/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
                 'nativeResources':(output/'native-resources.txt').read_text()}
    print(label,runs[label]['report']['editPlanExact'],flush=True)
previous=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/composition-adapter-2026-09-16.json').read_text())
comparisons={}
for label,current in runs.items():
    before={r['id']:r for r in previous[label]['predictions']}
    fields=['rawModelOutput','output','outcome']
    comparisons[label]={field:sum(row[field]==before[row['id']][field] for row in current['predictions']) for field in fields}
    comparisons[label]['cases']=len(before)
    comparisons[label]['previousMeasurements']=previous[label]['report']['measurements']
def identity(path):
    return dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),byteSize=path.stat().st_size)
record=dict(status='Precision diagnostic only; no promotion or release holdout query.',
            conversion='All248LoRA tensors F32→BF16; unchanged4bitbase/config/tokenizer; no fusion or retraining.',
            sourceAdapter=identity(source/'adapters/adapters.safetensors'),
            convertedAdapter=identity(model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors'),
            comparison= comparisons,probeSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),**runs)
Path('Training/experiments/adapter-precision-2026-09-16.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(comparisons),flush=True)
